description: Elections Commission - Notify the appointment of R. Kenkatharan as a member to the Valikamam-South Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Valikamam South Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member. The content details the process of nominating and declaring a new member elected under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of election results for government bodies.
